title: Clean slugs and a massive GLM upgrade
summary:
A heavy routing day: smarter image load balancing, auto-updating model slugs, and a massive context bump for GLM.

Unversioned model slugs (`openai-large`, `claude-large`, `gemini`) now automatically resolve to the newest models (GPT-5.5, Opus 4.8, 3.5 Flash) while preserving older versions under specific names. We also bumped the `glm` slug to GLM-5.2, expanding the context window to 1M tokens and slicing the pollen cost in half.

The image generation load balancer now weights routing based on recent latency rather than a uniform distribution. Faster hardware like 4090s will naturally absorb more traffic. We also isolated the latency tracking in the KV store to stop race conditions from wiping the weights. Net result: fewer timeouts, faster pixels.

Claude Opus 4.7 and 4.8 were throwing 500s on global Bedrock profiles, so we forced them to `us.*` regions. Meanwhile, Gemini was leaking proxy health strings into completions, so we reverted to direct Vertex connections. Responses should be reliable and artifact-free again.

highlights.title: Transaction History
highlights.text: You can now see exactly where your Pollen is going. Check your last 5 requests directly on the Pollen page, or browse the full history on your [Dashboard](https://enter.pollinations.ai).

highlights.title: Siriusly Fast Elevators
highlights.text: The Sirius Cybernetics Elevator Challenge app now defaults to Mistral, dropping response times from 10s to 1.2s. Even the API errors are now delivered in-character. [Try it](https://pollinations.ai)

highlights.title: Faster Image Generation
highlights.text: We rewired the [image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/image/models) load balancer to favor GPUs with the lowest recent latency. More traffic goes to the 4090s, meaning fewer timeouts and faster pixels.

highlights.title: GLM-5.2 Upgrade
highlights.text: The `glm` model slug now points to Z.ai's GLM-5.2, expanding the context window from 198k to a massive 1 million tokens.

highlights.title: Auto-Upgrading Model Slugs
highlights.text: Clean slugs like `openai-large` and `claude-large` now automatically resolve to the latest versions (like GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8). If you need the old stuff, versioned slugs still work. Check the [available models](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models).
